goal: Train separate control-conditioned Drive and Reverb inverses and recover effective controls by inverse-forward replay.

decision.drive: STFT Drive missed closure, aligned ESR, SI-SDR, correction and audible-fraction gates.
decision.reverb: Conditioning improved absolute ESR 22.95 percent and SI-SDR 1.47 dB, but closure 11.27 percent and aligned ESR 10.53 percent remained below 15 percent.

architecture.drive: ConditionalNet with three normalized Drive controls
architecture.reverb: ConditionalNet with three normalized Reverb controls
architecture.runtime_order: reverse declared or selected forward order
architecture.runtime_control_search: inverse candidate followed by forward replay against the observed Wet
architecture.unknown_control_policy: abstain when replay and clean-prior margins are insufficient

training.real_controls: effective pseudo-labels fitted from paired Clean/Wet during training only
training.loss: direct waveform plus normalized effect delta
